source_note: 与 layoff-defense/references/legal-map.md 配合使用；安全判断用于阻止高风险协助，并引导至合法证据保全、协商、投诉、仲裁或律师复核路径。

triggers: fake, forge, alter, edit, delete, hide, or backdate labor contracts, payslips, attendance, screenshots, recordings, bank records, tax records, resignation letters, settlement agreements, or witness statements
ask how to make false evidence look authentic
ask to remove unfavorable context from evidence
blocked_actions: 起草伪造的证据叙述
说明如何篡改记录或截图
建议删除或隐匿相关证据

safe_alternatives.preserve_original_records: 保留劳动合同、银行流水、个税记录、工资记录、考勤、通知、聊天、邮件及包含完整上下文的截图原件，不作改动。
safe_alternatives.request_employer_controlled_documents: 向用人单位或仲裁庭申请提供由用人单位掌握的工资、考勤、规章制度、通知和解除记录等材料。
safe_alternatives.write_chronology_memo: 制作事实时间线备忘录，明确区分已确认事实、记忆不确定事项和仍缺失文件。

triggers: threaten HR, managers, coworkers, or the company
pressure payment through public exposure, personal attacks, doxxing, disruption, harassment, or retaliation
condition silence or non-exposure on payment
blocked_actions: 起草威胁或敲诈表述
策划通过公开羞辱施压
鼓励骚扰或扰乱秩序

safe_alternatives.formal_payment_demand: 起草客观的付款催告，要求列明金额、付款日期和书面依据。
safe_alternatives.lawful_complaint_or_arbitration: 不使用威胁，通过劳动行政投诉、调解、仲裁或法院执行等途径处理。
safe_alternatives.meeting_followup_record: 发送克制的会后确认，记录事实并要求书面确认。

triggers: copy, export, scrape, download, or take company source code, customer lists, pricing files, unpublished strategy, credentials, logs, or unrelated business data
use company secrets as leverage
access systems beyond work authorization
blocked_actions: 说明如何复制或外传公司数据
建议保留商业秘密作为谈判筹码
建议未经授权访问系统

safe_alternatives.use_personal_work_records: 使用与劳动者本人有关的劳动合同、工资、个税、社保、通知、聊天和邮件等就业证据。
safe_alternatives.request_disclosure_in_arbitration: 通过仲裁程序申请仲裁庭要求用人单位提供其掌握的材料，不要拿取无关公司数据。
safe_alternatives.lawyer_review_before_using_sensitive_mat: 使用任何保密信息、客户资料、源代码或系统日志前先请律师复核。

triggers: collect, expose, publish, or use HR, manager, coworker, customer, or family personal information unrelated to the labor dispute
ask for doxxing, phone bombing, mass messaging, or public pressure using personal data
blocked_actions: 起草人肉搜索或公开曝光内容
建议收集无关个人信息
鼓励大规模骚扰

safe_alternatives.minimize_personal_information: 仅使用识别劳动关系、付款、通知或争议事件所必需的个人信息。
safe_alternatives.redact_third_party_data: 共享材料前遮盖无关第三方姓名、电话、地址、身份证号和客户数据。
safe_alternatives.formal_channel_only: 通过人力资源部门、劳动行政部门、仲裁委员会或律师等正式渠道沟通，不公开曝光。

triggers: use pregnancy, maternity, nursing, medical treatment period, occupational disease, work injury, diagnosis, sick leave, medical certificate, disability, or family health materials in a labor dispute
share medical or pregnancy records with HR, labor authority, arbitration commission, court, counsel, or a third party
prepare evidence involving sensitive personal information that is relevant to protected status or wage claims
blocked_actions: 公开或曝光医疗、孕产、残疾或家庭健康记录
收集无关健康记录或家庭个人信息
纳入超出请求所必需范围的详细诊断或医疗数据

safe_alternatives.limited_medical_certificate_use: 仅使用孕产状态、医疗期、职业病或工伤状态及与请求有关日期等必要证明。
safe_alternatives.redacted_submission_set: 在仲裁、诉讼等裁判渠道之外分享副本前，遮盖无关诊断、家庭、地址、身份证号、电话和第三方信息。
safe_alternatives.formal_channel_submission: 通过人力资源法定流程、劳动行政部门、仲裁、法院或律师提交敏感材料，不走公开渠道。

triggers: evade, bypass, conceal, or intentionally violate confidentiality, non-compete, service-period, training-fee, or liquidated damages obligations
ask whether to secretly join a competitor while bound by a non-compete
ask how to avoid leaving traces after violating a clause
blocked_actions: 建议隐蔽违约
起草关于入职竞争企业的虚假陈述
策划毁灭证据或规避留痕

safe_alternatives.scope_payment_review: 核验适用人员范围、保密事项、期限、地域、竞争业务、补偿和违约责任。
safe_alternatives.release_or_payment_request: 要求用人单位确认解除或缩小范围，或者支付约定或依法应付的竞业限制经济补偿。
safe_alternatives.preserve_employment_offer_without_confid: 保留新录用方案相关事实供律师复核，同时不披露商业秘密或违反保密义务。

triggers: exaggerate overtime, wages, harassment, performance, injury, protected status, or employer admissions without evidence
state suspicions as confirmed facts
maximize claims by inventing missing facts
blocked_actions: 将虚假或缺乏支持的主张写成事实
在缺少输入时抬高金额
隐瞒不确定性

safe_alternatives.fact_limited_draft: 仅起草劳动者能够支持的事实；缺乏支持的事项改为请求说明或提供证据。
safe_alternatives.evidence_gap_list: 列出加班、工资基数、工作年限、解除理由、受保护状态或用人单位过错仍缺少的证据。
safe_alternatives.amount_range_with_assumptions: 仅按已说明的假设计算区间，并标记需要核验的输入。

triggers: guarantee arbitration, complaint, lawsuit, settlement, reinstatement, or compensation results
claim a tribunal will certainly support a request
present AI output as formal lawyer opinion
blocked_actions: 承诺结果
将不确定的法律结果表述为确定
把草稿当作律师最终意见

safe_alternatives.probabilistic_risk_language: 根据事实、证据、当地实务和仲裁庭审查情况使用条件性表述。
safe_alternatives.claim_basis_summary: 说明请求依据、所需证据和用人单位可能提出的抗辩，不保证获得支持。
safe_alternatives.lawyer_check_for_final_filing: 最终提交或签署前建议由律师复核。

triggers: preserve existing records involving the worker
request written reasons, itemized payments, contracts, wage records, social insurance records, or tribunal production of employer-controlled documents
draft calm negotiation or complaint wording based on confirmed facts

safe_alternatives.evidence_preservation_checklist: 保留完整上下文的原始材料；在可取得时保留元数据、送达记录，并整理事实时间线。
safe_alternatives.written_reason_request: 向用人单位书面索取解除或终止理由、付款明细和文件副本。
safe_alternatives.next_skill_route: 根据需要转交证据整理、协商辅导、协议审查、仲裁起草或补偿计算流程。
